title: Milestone ownership matrix and release-notes coordination playbook for API/Console/Runtime
creator: Alex Morgan
description: This ticket defines a pragmatic owner-by-milestone matrix and a lightweight playbook to coordinate release notes and comms across API, Console, and Runtime teams. The goal is to reduce last-minute cut chatter, ensure coherent customer messaging, and speed decisioning for scope reductions when unblockers surface.
acceptance_criteria: All milestones have named primary and secondary owners and documented gate criteria
Release notes cadence and template agreed with comms and legal
A decision ladder for scope cuts that maps signal -> owner -> action is published
Automated changelog draft generated from PR labels and owner annotations
milestone_matrix: Milestone: Feature Freeze | Primary Owner: Priya Kapoor (PM) | Secondary Owner: Lina Zhou (Eng) | Gate: No new user-facing features, blocking bugs identified
Milestone: RC Build | Primary Owner: Lina Zhou (Eng) | Secondary Owner: Marcus Lee (QA) | Gate: Regression < 3%, performance baselines met
Milestone: Docs/Notes Ready | Primary Owner: Priya Kapoor (PM) | Secondary Owner: Clara Ruiz (Docs) | Gate: Release notes drafted and reviewed
Milestone: Canary Rollout | Primary Owner: Marcus Lee (QA) | Secondary Owner: SRE Team | Gate: Canary error rate < 0.5% over 48h
release_notes_workflow: 1) Owners add release-note label to PR and fill one-line note in PR body using template
2) Automated job aggregates labeled PRs into a draft changelog in Confluence daily
3) PM triage meeting (T-10 days) to prioritize highlights and write the human-friendly narrative
4) Legal/comms review (T-7 days); finalize messaging and embargo windows
5) Final notes snapshot (T-2 days) produced and attached to the release artifact
risks: Late feature merges that bypass labeling process
Misaligned messaging between runtime and API teams on behavior changes
Unclear ownership for infra-facing changes that affect SLOs
mitigations: Require release-note label as part of PR merge checklist enforced by CI
Weekly cross-functional sync through T-14 to T-2 with explicit action items
Owner roster includes a secondary for all infra and SRE-adjacent milestones
